title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-mbm7: fuzz_fragment calls Fragment::from_bytes with wrong arity
description:
File: rust/lichen-schc/fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_fragment.rs

The diff removed the `tile` buffer and changed `Fragment::from_bytes(data, &mut tile)` to `Fragment::from_bytes(data)`. However, `Fragment::from_bytes` (fragment.rs:175) still has the signature `pub fn from_bytes(data: &[u8], out: &'a mut [u8]) -> Result<Self, FragmentError>` requiring two arguments. The method signature was NOT updated in this commit. This will cause a compile error when building the fuzz target.

The fragment.rs changes were limited to `check_rule` widening and 2-byte Ack canonical validation; `Fragment::from_bytes` was untouched.
